Libertad en Bici, rodada del miércoles

Libertad en Bici Wednesday night ride

Mexico City, Mexico · Leyes de Reforma, Iztapalapa · Social

Libertad en Bici, rodada del miércoles is a social group ride in Mexico City, Mexico. It rolls every Wednesday at 8:15 pm local time from Eje 5 Sur y Calle 10 de Agosto.

For visitors

Group size is capped at 25 in the city's filing. It was not listed on Wed Sept 2 or Sept 16 in the agenda pages checked, so confirm the week with the collective before travelling across town.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Libertad en Bici, rodada del miércoles group ride

An evening group ride from the east side of Mexico City. It meets at Eje 5 Sur and Calle 10 de Agosto in Iztapalapa and rides to a different place each week: Miguel Hidalgo on Sept 9, the Unidad Independencia in Magdalena Contreras on Sept 23, the Ángel de la Independencia on Sept 30.
